name: Dining table, Vitra Guéridon Ø 110
notes: Vitra Guéridon (design Jean Prouvé, 1949) at Ø 110 cm and 74 cm high. Ø 110 is the size asked for, but Vitra makes the Guéridon only in Ø 90 and Ø 105 cm (both 74 cm high), so this size doesn't exist: the base is Vitra's Ø 105 base from its dimension drawing, widened by 5 % to match the top (the feet stand on a circle of Ø 105 cm). Three solid-wood legs, one pointing to the front, joined by a black tubular steel crossbar with round linking plates. Vitra makes it in natural oak, American walnut and dark oak; dark oak is the default, for the dark brown asked for. The surface is the largest square on the round top (77 × 77 cm). No clearance zone of its own; the chairs around it carry theirs.
